newsitem.title: GERMANY: W.German Jan CPI raised by seasonal, basis factors.
newsitem.headline: W.German Jan CPI raised by seasonal, basis factors.

text.p: West German consumer prices rose a preliminary 0.4 percent in January from December, while the yearly rate accelerated to 1.8 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said on Monday.
The Office said the month-on-month rise in the consumer price index, based on figures from four states in western Germany, was mainly driven by seasonal and weather factors.
The jump in the yearly rate, which stood at 1.4 percent in December, resulted from the basis effect of the abolition of the "coal penny" subsidy, the office said.
Final German inflation data for January are expected to be released in mid-February.
